## How To Disable Option To Complete Member's Address Based On The Map's Marker


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000065750

Member's of the directory have the option to select and set their location based on the location of the marker in the map on the Contact Details form:

Use the Advanced Setting:

Disable Drag-able Pins on Member Google Maps

System Variable: disable_drag_drop_member_map

Once the Advanced Setting is enabled, the option to move the pin is gone:
